notes.title: Major Bug Fix and in other news SLC Gaming Con
notes.notes:
Howdy There,

We've got a surprise bug fix for y'all. While one of our gunslingers was running around they came across a game breaking bug which prevented them from playing the boss level. We've patched it up.

In other news, we'll be at Salt Lake City Gaming Com on the 7th and 8th. If you're in town you can swing by and find us by the Microsoft booth at booth number 1017. You'll have a chance to meet the team and we'll also have some stations set up so you can play.

=== Patch Notes ===
- Game-Breaking bug preventing boss level access fixed
- Fixed issue where stats on boss level wouldn't show correctly
- Player can now correctly dash on boss level

notes.title: UPDATE AND SUMMER SALE
notes.notes:
Players!
Grab your cowboy boots and reload your revolvers! We are now part of the Summer Sale!
We have also officially released our first update. This is an update focused on solving the small User Experience problems all of you were facing and also a few bugs. 
We noticed a lot of requests for more options in the settings menu. The biggest change you will notice is that the options menu now has volume sliders and resolution settings. 
We have noticed a few more bugs that were in several youtube reviews which were fixed as well. 
What you can expect from us next will be more gameplay content changes along with more weapons and enemies.

PATCH NOTES: 
- Make Menus and game more keyboard&mouse friendly
- Update Level up menu to correctly display text on mouse Hover
- Enemies spawn with agro on boss level
- Calculate a score based on time, kills, and accuracy
- pressing A to continue doesn't vibrate controller
- Show new enemy being introduced on each level
- New Options Menu with Volume controls and resolution settings
- Level Up Notification
- Updated chest to explode on shoot
- Tiling Improvements
- UI Changes

-The CR Team
